tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Symmetry of Green's function] ↗ def:greens-function 1. ch2:2.2-thm-13\group Green’s Functions

For distinct $x,y\in U$, \[ G(y,x)=G(x,y). \]
Proof

\sketch Apply Green’s identity to $G(x,\cdot )$ and $G(y,\cdot )$ on $U\setminus (B(x,\varepsilon )\cup B(y,\varepsilon ))$. The outer boundary terms vanish. As $\varepsilon \downarrow 0$, the two small-sphere integrals converge to $G(y,x)$ and $G(x,y)$, respectively.

□
